title: Thirty Days Later

pre.en: What has Lily been doing every night at a quarter to eleven?
pre.zh: Lily 每天晚上十点四十五都在干什么？

intro: 单元的融汇课：一个月前，兄妹俩把各自的习惯清单贴在冰箱上，今天坐下来对账。本单元说习惯的说法在这里全用上了：every other day、used to、would、be used to doing、keep doing、tend to、had better。读的时候留意 used to stay（以前常熬夜）和 got used to having（已经习惯了）的区别。结尾有反转。

sentences.en: Right, we stuck these lists on the fridge exactly thirty days ago.
sentences.zh: 好，这两张清单是咱们整整三十天前贴到冰箱上的。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: So let's see how we've done.
sentences.zh: 来看看做得怎么样。

sentences.en: Keep in mind that most people tend to give up after three weeks.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，大多数人坚持三个星期就放弃了。

sentences.en: You go first.
sentences.zh: 你先来。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: You're the one who keeps track of everything in a notebook.
sentences.zh: 什么事都记在本子上的人是你。

sentences.en: Fine.
sentences.zh: 行。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: I've stuck to my ten thousand steps every other day.
sentences.zh: 隔一天走一万步，我一直坚持着。

sentences.en: On average, I've walked six kilometres a day.
sentences.zh: 平均下来，我每天走了六公里。

sentences.en: And I've got into the habit of cooking on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 还养成了周日做饭的习惯。

sentences.en: Oh, and Dan's Monday class is fully booked now, because I made half the hospital sign up.
sentences.zh: 对了，Dan 周一那节课现在都约满了，因为我把半个医院的人都拉去报名了。

sentences.en: No wonder he looked so tired at his talk.
sentences.zh: 难怪他讲座那天看着那么累。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: My turn.
sentences.zh: 该我了。

sentences.en: I used to stay up until one, and now I'm in bed by eleven most nights.
sentences.zh: 我以前熬到一点才睡，现在大多数晚上十一点前就上床了。

sentences.en: To be honest, the first week dragged on.
sentences.zh: 说实话，第一个星期特别难熬。

sentences.en: I'd lie in bed staring at the ceiling, and I kept reaching for my phone.
sentences.zh: 我躺在床上盯着天花板，手老是往手机那儿伸。

sentences.en: But I haven't slipped back into skipping the gym.
sentences.zh: 不过健身房我没再翘过。

sentences.en: And I've even got used to having no coffee after two.
sentences.zh: 下午两点以后不喝咖啡，我居然也习惯了。

sentences.en: You even put your mugs away now.
sentences.zh: 你现在连杯子都会收好了。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: Mum got in touch with me last week just to check you were eating your vegetables.
sentences.zh: 上周妈专门联系我，就为了问你有没有好好吃菜。

sentences.en: I sent her a photo of your bitter melon.
sentences.zh: 我给她发了张你做的苦瓜的照片。

sentences.en: You'd better not stop now.
sentences.zh: 你现在可千万别停。

sentences.en: Apparently, it takes about sixty-six days for a new habit to stick.
sentences.zh: 据说，一个新习惯大概要六十六天才能养成。

sentences.en: So far so good.
sentences.zh: 目前为止还不错。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Honestly, I just couldn't put my phone down at night.
sentences.zh: 说真的，我以前一到晚上就是放不下手机。

sentences.en: Breaking that habit is the best thing I've done all year.
sentences.zh: 改掉这个习惯，是我今年做过的最好的一件事。

sentences.en: I'll be sorry to leave in June, you know.
sentences.zh: 跟你说，六月要走了，我还真有点舍不得。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: But I have to tell you something.
sentences.zh: 不过我得跟你坦白一件事。

sentences.en: Every night for a month, I've been changing the Wi-Fi password at a quarter to eleven.
sentences.zh: 这一个月，我每天晚上十点四十五都会改一次 Wi-Fi 密码。

sentences.en: Hang on.
sentences.zh: 等等。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: So that's why the Wi-Fi kept going down at night?
sentences.zh: 难怪一到晚上网就老断？

sentences.en: How much do you want for tonight's password?
sentences.zh: 今晚的密码，你开个价吧。

cards.note: refrigerator 的口语说法；冰箱贴是 fridge magnet。
to remember a fact when you are thinking or making a decision
to make sure you know what is happening or how much of something there is, often by writing it down
cards.tip: 反义是 lose track of sth（第 31 课的 lose track of time）。keep 的过去式 kept。
cards.example: I use an app to keep track of my spending.

cards.note: 英式里不指笔记本电脑，那是 laptop。
to keep doing what you planned or promised, even when it is difficult
cards.tip: stick 的过去式和过去分词都是 stuck；后面接名词：stick to a plan / a budget。
cards.example: It's hard to stick to a diet when you eat out a lot.

cards.note: used to say what is usual when you look at many different amounts
英式拼写，美式写 kilometer；英国人说距离其实更常用 mile。

cards.text: get into the habit of doing
cards.note: to start doing something regularly so that it becomes a habit
cards.tip: of 后面接 doing，不接 to do；英式过去分词 got，美式常用 gotten。
cards.example: I've got into the habit of checking my phone first thing in the morning.

cards.note: if a train, hotel or restaurant is fully booked, there are no seats or rooms left
报名参加什么用 for：sign up for a class。
used to say that something is not surprising
used before you say what you really think, especially something the listener may not like
to continue for longer than you want or expect
reach for sth 是伸手去拿；reach 也有「到达」的意思：reach London。
to start doing something bad again, often without meaning to
cards.tip: slip 是「滑」，过去式双写 p：slipped；后面接名词或 doing。
cards.example: After the holiday, it's easy to slip back into old habits.

cards.note: to put something back in the place where it is usually kept
cards.tip: 代词放中间：put it away；put 的三种形式都是 put。
cards.example: Put your toys away before dinner, please.

cards.note: to contact someone by phone, email or message
used to say that things have gone well until now
cards.tip: 带一点「还没结束，后面不好说」的意思；常单独成句。
cards.example: "How's the new job?" "So far so good."

cards.note: to find something so interesting that you cannot stop reading, watching or using it
cards.tip: 代词放中间：put it down；过去用 couldn't。
cards.example: I couldn't put the new book down last night.

cards.note: to stop doing something that you have done regularly for a long time
cards.tip: 冠词可以换：break the habit / break that habit；反义是 get into the habit of doing。
cards.example: It took him two years to break the habit of biting his nails.

cards.note: to feel sad because you have to go away from a place or people you like
cards.tip: 这里的 sorry 是「难过、舍不得」，不是道歉。
cards.example: We were all sorry to leave the little village.

cards.note: 改密码是 change a password；忘了密码是 forget your password。
if a computer system goes down, it stops working

cards.text: how much do you want for sth?
cards.note: a question you ask a seller when you want to know the price and maybe pay less
